name: Echoing Power [Metapsionic]
body:
You have learned how to release most, but not all, of a power’s potential when you manifest it.

Benefit: To use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. When you manifest an echoing power a portion of it remains in your power point pool, and you can manifest it one additional time during that day. This second manifesting does not expend any additional power points. Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 4. The power’s total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.
